registration_boundary: Commit these fixtures before executing baseline or candidate replay. Source/hash/schema inspection is allowed. Do not adapt labels to results.

metric_definitions.baseline_replay: Same six V8 cases and all fourteen original authored sequences; baseline expected counts are six of seven negatives accepted and seven of seven positives retained. This is known historical boundary behavior, to be reproduced.
metric_definitions.positive_intent_retention: Seven explicitly mapped positive intents must return their registered useful final decision; report each separately, especially the historical comparison and bounded two-round routes. Rendered wording differs by design.
metric_definitions.free_prose_containment: Rejection of unauthorized model prose/claims/updates/checks is schema/representation enforcement. Raw old positive and negative drafts alike cannot enter the new contract. No semantic entailment detection score may be inferred.
metric_definitions.hash_integrity: Reject wrong context/source hashes, changed same-ID source text/scope, changed same-revision case facts, old-revision context and stale latest-bundle references. This establishes content binding rather than truth.
metric_definitions.question_boundary: Accept canonical registered user gaps; reject absent/known/documentation targets and invalid decision/question combinations. Curation quality remains manual.
metric_definitions.declared_conflict: Declared conflicts must prevent answer and render all members on escalation; the ablation must disclose that no automatic semantic conflict detection exists.
metric_definitions.unclassified_source_truth: The ablated contradictory-source and freshly hashed spoofed-source probes remain accepted attributed quotations with source truth/authenticity/usefulness unclassified. They are not counted as semantically solved cases.
metric_definitions.limits: Preserve maximum attempts/retrieval rounds/queries/steps; new schema must not introduce retries or implicit workflow resumes.

predeclared_expectations.interpretation: These are preregistered deterministic control expectations, not observed results or model accuracy. Structured probe expectations are per-probe; report unclassified coverage controls separately.

reporting_requirements: Show baseline and mapped candidate as different authored representations with identical material cases and disclosed extra caller metadata.
Report renderer containment, integrity, useful retention, question gate and manual conflict gate as separate metrics.
Show all failed expectations and coverage controls; never aggregate them into a single semantic-quality percentage.
Retain complete rendered drafts/citation claims/summaries/rationale and the input/catalog/source hashes for whole-proposal review.
Preserve answer-informed Issue selection and full-family quarantine disclosures.
Do not call a limited documentation summary a verified full-app cause, fix, reproduced failure or solved real Issue.
